ff8b0092-75ce-4b8f-8e4a-00ca7269f16b.description: Set up data collection system for outreach responses within a specific timeframe.
success_criteria: Data is collected from CRM or email marketing platform
Timeframe (e.g. last week, month) is defined and set as filter

134ef575-bcad-407b-9872-2946a2d47e69.description: Export data on respondents within the specified timeframe.
success_criteria: Data export process is established with CRM or email marketing platform
Correctly formatted CSV/Excel file containing respondent information exists

7bd51a3f-ca0a-4c2b-98f3-fb73f7c27733.description: Analyze and segment respondents based on demographics, firmographics (e.g., company size), job function/department.
success_criteria: Insights into common characteristics among responders are gathered from analysis of exported data
Segmentation criteria for refined buyer profile is defined

17adb4b6-8ccb-4dbe-8408-2ed046a806f3.description: Evaluate and refine initial segmentation with additional demographic information (if available) or other relevant factors.
success_criteria: Additional insights from further analysis of exported data are integrated into refined buyer profile
Updated segment criteria accurately represents target audience characteristics based on the latest findings

7d263ef6-f2bc-4075-9b36-93457036cad7.description: Update sales teams' knowledge of refined buyer profile through training or internal communication.
success_criteria: All members of the relevant departments have received information about updated target audience and segmentation criteria

a847c2dc-f924-4791-9cc5-fe8839327ced.description: Monitor results from outreach campaigns to determine effectiveness based on refined buyer profile.
success_criteria: Comparison of before-and-after performance metrics is tracked using CRM or email marketing platform

fc297dad-2e6d-41d4-a5a5-e343e174ebaf.description: Refine target buyer profile based on who responded to our outreach efforts within a specific timeframe (e.g., last week, month) with an aim for increased relevance of prospects.
success_criteria: Complete: Refine target buyer profile based on who responded to our outreach efforts within a specific timeframe (e.g., last week, month) with an aim for increased relevance of prospects.
